description: Create an association between two CRM objects, with an optional HubSpot-defined association type ID.

associationTypeId.description: HubSpot-defined association type ID for the association; when omitted, the default HUBSPOT_DEFINED association is created.

objectId.description: The ID of the source object to associate from.

objectType.description: The CRM object type of the source object, such as contacts, companies, deals, or tickets.

toObjectId.description: The ID of the object to associate to.

toObjectType.description: The object type of the object to associate to, such as contacts, companies, deals, or tickets.

name: hubspot_create_association
